deferred.Text3D: a single label with no data rows; use Text

errors.required: Facet requires a row or column field, fields, or pairs.
errors.wrap: Facet wrap takes a positive integer (cells per line) with one facet field, row or column.
errors.fields: Facet fields takes a nonempty list of distinct column names, or {row: [...]} or {column: [...]}.
errors.fieldsDimension: Facet fields lays its cells out along {dimension}s, so it cannot combine with {dimension}="{field}"; use fields={{{other}: [...]}} or {other}="{field}".
errors.pairs: Facet pairs takes a nonempty list of distinct column names, or {x: [...], y: [...]}.
errors.pairsCombine: Facet pairs cannot combine with row, column, or fields.
errors.triangle: Facet triangle must be full, upper, or lower.
errors.triangleXY: Facet triangle applies to pairs={[...]} (one list); with {x, y} lists only diagonal applies.
errors.diagonal: Facet diagonal must be true or false.
errors.pairsOnly: Facet triangle and diagonal apply only with pairs.
errors.as: Facet as renames the value/field aliases (fields) or x/y (pairs).
errors.asNames: Facet as names must be distinct, nonempty, and not start with "@".
errors.pairOrder: Pair facet order must contain distinct selected fields.
errors.order: Facet order must contain unique category values.
errors.pairsNumeric: Facet pairs requires numeric columns; "{field}" is not one.
errors.missingField: Facet {prop}: the data has no column "{field}".
